gold: Juvenile spring eruption (JSE) associated with parvovirus B19 infection

gold_candidate.label: Parvovirus B19 infection
for: Serum parvovirus B19 (PVB19) IgM and IgG antibodies were detectable
PVB19 DNA was found (viral load of 0.2 PVB19 DNA copies/β-globin gene copy, or 33,438 copies/μg of isolated DNA) in lesional skin biopsy specimen

champion_candidate.label: Erythema multiforme
for: Erythema and helical thickening as well as numerous small blisters, 2 to 3 mm in diameter, were present on both ears
Similar vesicles were observed at the upper and lower vermillion border
Several erythematous papules and crusts were located on the cheeks, neck, and lower arms
